proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING DECLASSIFICATION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS
proposals.proponent: Connecticut Retirement Plans and Trust Fund (CRPTF)
proposals.topic_summary: Urges the board to eliminate the classification of the board so that all directors stand for election annually, without affecting unexpired terms.
proposals.evidence: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING DECLASSIFICATION OF THE BOARD.
